subject: Workplace Skills
title: The Servant Leadership Model
description: A fast breakdown of The Servant Leadership Model for builders.

hook.text: Robert Greenleaf proposed in 1970 that the best leaders serve first. Decades of research has proven him right.

buildup.text: Traditional leadership puts the leader at the top. Servant leadership inverts the pyramid: the team comes first.

discovery.text: Servant leaders ask: what do you need to succeed? Then they remove obstacles instead of issuing commands.

twist.text: Serving doesn't mean being passive. Servant leaders still set high standards. They just clear the path to reach them.

climax.text: Flip your question from 'what did you produce?' to 'what's blocking you?' Watch productivity transform.

punchline.text: Serve first. Remove obstacles. Results follow naturally.

quiz.question: What distinguishes servant leadership from traditional leadership?
options: Servant leaders avoid setting standards to keep the team happy
Servant leaders prioritize removing team obstacles over issuing commands
Servant leaders only work in nonprofit organizations
